text:
marta_ae: FYI NorthValley Finance asked to run a BYO-CMK POC next month. They're pushing for a pen-test window + a rotation dry-run during the POC. Need ops & sec input on feasibility and cost implications.

sam_sales: tl;dr: customer wants to bring their own CMK (HSM-backed) for all inference traffic, do an internal pentest during week 2, and run a key rotation rehearsal at cutover. They asked for an estimate on any extra monthly fees and a timeline.

leo_engops: We can support BYO CMK via our HSM proxy. Main considerations: network egress whitelisting, latency delta ~8-15ms avg for key unwrap on each token signing call (depends on CloudHSM path), and throughput limits if they hit high concurrency.

alexa_sec: Security checklist: attestation report (if they're using customer HSM), KMS audit logs shipped to their SIEM, and a signed key-handshake proof for the handover. Also need SOC2 / ISO evidence and a 3rd-party pen-test waiver template if they want to run tests against our dedicated nodes.

leo_engops: For the pen-test window: ops needs a 72h scheduled maintenance slot (isolated traffic mirroring) and pre-signed IP whitelist for our control plane. Can we give them a staging endpoint in their VPC?

marta_ae: They prefer a staging endpoint in their VPC (private deploy). Ask was: can Redwood stand up a private staging with our Private package for the POC? They'll cover infra cost for a 2-week staging box.

sam_sales: Pricing question: what are the incremental costs we should quote for BYO-CMK (HSM proxy bandwidth, reserved HSM minutes, additional audit retention)? Also need a simple line item for the pen-test support SLA.

leo_engops: Priceable items: 1) HSM proxy throughput reserve (monthly) — covers CloudHSM nodes we allocate. 2) Secure key ingress/outgress egress bandwidth (if cross-AZ) — observable metric. 3) Extra KMS audit retention / log export to customer S3 / SIEM (30/90/365 day tiers). For a 2-week POC, we can cap HSM cost estimate as a short-term reserve.

alexa_sec: For the pen-test: we require a test plan 7 days prior, scope list (IP ranges + vectors), and mandatory safe-words/process. We'll provide an incident contact list and rollback plan. Pen-test support (ops on-call) is billable at the standard Professional Services hourly rate.

leo_engops: Operational checklist for preflight (high level):
- Customer supplies signed attestation + public key thumbprint.
- We exchange handshake manifest and verify key policy.
- Open firewall rules:
```
allow-from: xx.xx.xx.xx/32 (customer pen-test bastion)
allow-to: our-staging-proxy:443
```
- Schedule 72h maintenance window for traffic mirroring and simulated failover.
- Dry-run rotation: run rotation on a single model route with canary fallback.

marta_ae: Also asked about rotation cadence — they want daily ephemeral intermediate keys during POC. Is that supported?

leo_engops: We can automate ephemeral KEK wrapping daily during POC. Caveat: daily rotations increase HSM ops by ~3x due to more unwraps/wraps; call volume spike may push them into a higher throughput tier. We'll note a delta cost.

sam_sales: Can you give me a short script/snippet we can send the customer to explain firewall + test plan? Keep it non-technical but exact enough for their infra team.

leo_engops: Sending a concise snippet (feel free to edit for customer tone):
```
Redwood preflight checklist for BYO-CMK POC:
1) Provide HSM attestation report and public key fingerprint.
2) Whitelist Redwood staging proxy IPs: 3x addresses we'll provide.
3) Schedule the pen-test window (we require 7 days notice).
4) Confirm rotation cadence (we support ephemeral daily rotations during POC; higher throughput may apply).
5) Confirm log export destination (S3 bucket or SIEM connector).
```

alexa_sec: Add: "Provide a signed test scope and acceptance criteria for the pen-test; no data-exfil tests without prior approval."

marta_ae: Great — I'll package this into the SOW draft. One remaining enterprise blocker: legal asked about key escrow/replication. Customer wants multi-region key mirroring for HA — is that ok?

leo_engops: We support multi-region key mirrors but for BYO HSM the customer must manage replication policy on their HSM pair; Redwood can provide the orchestration hooks and config recommendations. Multi-region will add cross-region egress fees and slightly higher key unwrap latency for failover.

sam_sales: Final ask from customer: can we commit to an SLA for rotation success during the POC? They want a >99.9% rotation success window or automatic rollback.

leo_engops: For POC we can promise monitored rotation with automatic canary rollback and post-run audit. We won't bind a financial SLA for rotations in a short-term POC, but we will provide runbooks and run a joint dry-run with their team.

marta_ae: OK — action items: 1) leo_engops to send cost estimate and preflight checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) alexa_sec to draft pen-test support requirements & waiver template. 3) sam_sales to add the three line items to the SOW: HSM reserve, audit export, pen-test support. 4) marta_ae to schedule kickoff with customer for next Tuesday.

marta_ae: thanks all. I'll ping once kickoff is scheduled. :thumbsup:
